# Prototypes

This folder holds the product's prototypes. It is used in two design modes (`design.mode` in `factory/config.yaml`, chosen in Discovery step 5); in `spec` mode it stays empty apart from this file.

## `html_prototypes`: generated by the factory

The UX/UI Designer generates static HTML screens here for you to open in a browser and approve.

- `index.html` links every screen, with the user stories each one covers. Open it first.
- One file per screen, named `<screen-id>-<name>.html` (for example `s03-login.html`), matching the screen list in `factory/input/05-design-spec.md`.
- `assets/styles.css` is the one shared stylesheet, built from the design tokens in the design spec. Every screen links it; no screen repeats CSS. Changing a token changes every screen.
- No build step, no frameworks and no external resources: the files open directly from disk, offline.
- To request changes, tell the Orchestrator what to change; the designer edits the affected screens or the stylesheet.

## `user_prototypes`: made by you in other tools

Put your own prototypes here before or during Discovery step 5: exported images, PDFs, HTML exports, or design-tool exports.

- Name each file `<screen-id>-<name>.<ext>` (for example `s03-login.png`, `s07-checkout.pdf`). If you don't have screen IDs yet, use a short name (`login.png`) and the designer assigns IDs in the spec.
- One screen or state per file is easiest to map; put extra states in separate files (`s03-login-error.png`).
- Supporting assets (logos, icons, fonts you own) go in `assets/`.
- The UX/UI Designer inventories the files, maps them to screens and user stories, and extracts the design spec from them. It does not rename or modify your files.

## Git

Like everything under `factory/`, this folder is ignored by git and exists only on this machine. Back it up with the rest of `factory/`.
